payload.title: Replace the bundled example mission and sections with neutral ones
payload.description:
Requested by Humorus (https://github.com/AnthusAI/Humorus), the satire publications that run a second, very different newsroom on Papyrus. Humorus issue: HUM-e30752.

The examples under `corpora/example-*.yml` belong to one existing publication and are bundled into the router. Replace them so a new site cannot be seeded with another site's mission.
